title: Bitcoin Price Slips Below $64,000 as Strategy (MSTR) Falls Below $100
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slips Below $64,000 as Strategy (MSTR) Falls Below $100 Bitcoin price slipped near $64,000 Tuesday afternoon as Strategy (MSTR) shares fell below the company's STRC preferred and Coinbase and other crypto stocks declined. This post Bitcoin Price Slips Below $64,000 as Strategy (MSTR) Falls Below $100 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
